## CLAUSE 2 — SALE AND PURCHASE

### 2.1 Agreement to Sell and Buy

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, at Closing the Seller shall sell, and the Buyer shall purchase, the Sale Shares, free and clear of all Encumbrances, with full title guarantee and together with all rights attaching to them at Closing (including all dividends or distributions declared, made, or paid after the Accounts Date, except as expressly permitted under Clause 5).

### 2.2 Sale Shares

The Sale Shares are described in **Schedule 2**. The Seller represents that the Sale Shares constitute [100]% of the issued and outstanding share capital of the Company.

### 2.3 Title and Risk

Title to and risk in the Sale Shares shall pass to the Buyer at Closing upon payment of the Closing Payment in accordance with Clause 3.

### 2.4 Single Transaction

The sale and purchase of the Sale Shares shall constitute a single indivisible transaction and neither Party shall be obliged to complete the purchase of some but not all of the Sale Shares.

### 4.2 Satisfaction of Conditions

(b) Neither Party shall take, or omit to take, any action that would reasonably be expected to prevent or materially delay satisfaction of any Condition.

(c) The Parties shall keep each other reasonably informed of the status of satisfaction of the Conditions.

(a) If any Condition has not been satisfied or waived by the Long Stop Date, either Party may terminate this Agreement in accordance with Clause 14, unless the non-satisfaction is attributable to the fault of the Party seeking to terminate.

(a) maintain its assets in good repair and working order;

(b) not make or permit any amendment to the constitutional documents of any Company Group member;

(c) not declare, make, or pay any dividend, distribution, or other return of capital, except as set out in Clause 5.4 / Schedule 3 (Leakage);

(d) not issue, allot, purchase, redeem, or grant any option over shares, or grant any Encumbrance over the Sale Shares;

(e) not enter into, amend, or terminate any Material Contract with a value exceeding [●] without the Buyer's prior written consent;

(f) not incur Financial Indebtedness exceeding [●] in aggregate (other than under existing facilities);

(g) not make capital expenditures exceeding [●] in aggregate;

(h) not change its accounting policies or practices;

(i) not settle, compromise, or acknowledge any litigation or claim with a value exceeding [●];

(j) not make, change, or revoke any material Tax election or settle any material Tax controversy; and

(k) maintain all material Permits and comply in all material respects with applicable law.

Full list of restricted actions and ordinary course permissions is set out in **Schedule 5**.

### 5.2 Access

From the date of this Agreement until Closing, the Seller shall (subject to applicable law, privilege, and confidentiality obligations) procure that the Buyer and its representatives are given reasonable access to the Company Group's books, records, management, and premises, upon reasonable prior notice and during normal business hours, for the purpose of monitoring compliance with this Clause 5.

### 5.3 Notification

Each Party shall promptly notify the other Party in writing upon becoming aware of:

(a) any fact, matter, or circumstance that would, or would reasonably be expected to, result in any Condition not being satisfied or any Warranty being materially breached; or

(b) any material development in the Business.

## CLAUSE 10 — LIMITATIONS ON LIABILITY

### 10.1 Financial Caps

| Claim Type | Cap | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fundamental Warranty Claims | [100]% of Purchase Price | |
| General Warranty Claims | [[●]% of Purchase Price] | ⚠ OPEN — typically 15–30% |
| Specific Indemnity Claims | [100]% of Purchase Price (or per-item cap) | ⚠ OPEN |
| Tax Covenant Claims | [100]% of Purchase Price | |

### 10.2 De Minimis and Basket

(a) **De Minimis**: No Claim shall be brought unless the Losses in respect of such individual Claim (or a series of related Claims) exceed [●] ("**De Minimis**"). ⚠ OPEN

(b) **Basket / Deductible**: The Seller shall have no liability in respect of General Warranty Claims unless and until the aggregate of all valid Claims (net of the De Minimis) exceeds [●] ("**Basket**"), at which point the Seller's liability shall be for the excess above the Basket (deductible) / for the full amount (tipping basket). **⚠ OPEN — tipping vs. deductible to be negotiated.**

### 10.3 Time Limits for Claims

| Claim Type | Limitation Period |
|---|---|
| Fundamental Warranty Claims | [7] years from Closing |
| General Warranty Claims | [18–24] months from Closing ⚠ OPEN |
| Tax Covenant Claims | [7] years from Closing (or statutory period + 1 year) |
| Specific Indemnity Claims | As specified in Schedule 9 |

### 10.4 Other Limitations

(a) **No Double Recovery**: The Buyer shall not recover Losses more than once in respect of the same Loss.

(b) **Duty to Mitigate**: The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate any Loss.

(c) **Third-Party Claims**: The Buyer shall give the Seller prompt notice of any third-party claim and, at the Seller's election and cost, allow the Seller to assume conduct of the defence of such claim, subject to the Buyer's right to participate.

(d) **Insurance Proceeds**: Any amount recoverable under insurance (including a W&I Policy) shall reduce the amount recoverable from the Seller.

(e) **Tax Benefits**: Any Claim shall be reduced by Tax benefits obtained by the Buyer as a result of the matter giving rise to the Claim.

(f) **Matters Disclosed**: No Claim shall be made in respect of any matter that has been **fairly disclosed** in the Disclosure Letter.

(g) **Fraud**: Nothing in this Clause 10 shall limit liability for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation by the Seller.

## CLAUSE 14 — TERMINATION

### 14.1 Termination Rights

This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to Closing:

(a) by mutual written agreement of the Parties;

(b) by either Party, if the Long Stop Date has passed and any Condition remains unsatisfied or unwaived (provided the terminating Party is not in material breach of its obligations);

(c) by the Buyer, if:
- (i) there has been a material breach by the Seller of any representation, warranty, or covenant that is not cured within [20] Business Days of written notice; or
- (ii) a MAC has occurred;

(d) by the Seller, if:
- (i) there has been a material breach by the Buyer of any representation, warranty, or covenant that is not cured within [20] Business Days of written notice; or
- (ii) the Buyer has failed to pay the Closing Payment when due.

### 14.2 Effect of Termination

(a) Upon termination, this Agreement shall cease to have effect except for Clauses 13.3 (Confidentiality), 14.2 (Effect of Termination), 15.4 (Costs), and 15.9 (Governing Law), which shall survive termination.

(b) Termination shall not affect any rights or remedies accrued prior to termination.
